state_bit_order: bit 0 is the least significant bit
nibble_order: S-box j acts on bits 4*j..4*j+3, with bit 4*j as the nibble LSB
permutation_semantics: an S-box output bit at source position i is moved to destination P[i]
lat_definition: LAT[a][b] = sum over x in {0,...,15} of (-1)^parity((a & x) xor (b & S(x)))
trail_absolute_correlation: product of the absolute values of all 640 local S-box correlations

optimization_boundary.object: one linear characteristic/trail between the fixed masks, not a linear hull
optimization_boundary.required_claim: minimum absolute-correlation weight over all valid 20-round trails between the fixed masks

definitions.N: the number of active output nibbles entering the appended inverse round
definitions.m: the Hamming weight of the fixed output mask
